messages:
Nina (CS): Quick flag for Orchard Labs ahead of our QBR prep  their embedding pipeline spiked and cost projection is out of band. Need a short mitigation plan + slide.
Jorge (AE): thanks, saw the alert. Do we know if it's exploratory queries or a recurring backfill?
Anika (Solutions): ops traces show repeated midnight backfills from their analytics job + larger batch_size. Rough back-of-envelope: additional ~18k/mo.
Nina (CS): yikes. Can we get a 2-line projection and 2 tactical knobs? QBR slide needs an "ask" and a suggested credit/commit option.
Anika (Solutions): projection below: ```
Current forecast (w/ surge): $68,500/mo
Previous baseline: $50,500/mo
Delta: +$18,000 (+35.6%)
Renewal risk threshold breach: yes (variance >25%)
```
Jorge (AE): looping in @Sam (Finance) for credit/commit ideas. We should also propose short-term throttles so product doesn't break.
Sam (Finance): we can propose a $6k strategic easing credit if they sign a 90-day reserved capacity pilot. Need CS to confirm customer appetite.
Nina (CS): I'll call their lead tomorrow and surface the pilot + credit. Also want an enablement play to teach their infra team how to reduce unit cost without hurting quality.
Anika (Solutions): 15-min playbook for their infra team: 1) reduce batch_size for real-time paths, 2) split backfill into windowed jobs with sampling, 3) enable kv/prefix cache for duplicate rows. Snippet for their deploy config below:```yaml
embed_pipeline:
  mode: hybrid
  realtime_batch_size: 8
  backfill_batch_size: 32
  sampling: 0.2
  kv_cache: enabled
  max_requests_per_minute: 300
```
Jorge (AE): add note: embeddings quality verified by customer as unchanged after quantization test last month. Call that out as low-quality-risk.
Nina (CS): good point. Also capture performance note: latency starts to degrade when backfill_batch_size > 128.
Deck-bot: Reminder - QBR slides due in 48 hours. Please attach slides to #qbr-decks channel.
Nina (CS): action items: Anika -> update playbook + short demo runbook (20m); Sam -> draft credit/retainer language; Jorge -> collect usage pattern snippet from Orchard infra; Nina -> Customer sync + include ask on renewal slide. I'll paste artifacts here when ready. :white_check_mark:
